name: ODE and SDE library backends (torchdiffeq, torchsde, torchode, diffrax)
plain: Hands each step to an outside solver library, which picks its own internal steps. tde uses torchdiffeq, tsde torchsde, tode torchode and diffrax the JAX library. Each is optional and only offered when its library is installed. The README advises against SDE mode for now.
math:
Solve dx/dσ = (x − D(x, σ))/σ from σ to σ' with the library's method and tolerances.
Model calls = whatever the solver needs.
